Package com.bilt.pos.platform

Interface BiltPlatformClient

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
OkHttpPlatformClient
public interface BiltPlatformClient extends AutoCloseable
Executes authenticated requests against the Bilt platform.

This is the one seam through which every cloud-backed feature of the SDK reaches Bilt: member resolution, session registration, the retail media widget's decision and event calls, and widgets yet to come. It is deliberately small and transport-neutral. A request is a method, a relative path, headers and bytes; a response is a status, headers and bytes. Endpoint paths and payload shapes are owned by the features and by the platform integration spec, not by this interface.

Implementations own authentication end to end: they obtain an access token for the configured BiltCredentials, attach it to every request, refresh it before it expires and retry a request once when the platform reports the token stale. Callers never see a token.

OkHttpPlatformClient is the shipped implementation. Integrator tests may substitute their own; the value types have public builders for that purpose.

  • Method Details

    • execute

      PlatformResponse execute(PlatformRequest request) throws PlatformException
      Sends the request and blocks until the platform answers. Any HTTP status is returned as a PlatformResponse; only the failure to obtain one throws.
      Throws:
      PlatformAuthException - when no access token could be obtained
      PlatformException - when the exchange failed at the transport level
      IllegalStateException - when the client has been closed

    • executeAsync

      CompletableFuture<PlatformResponse> executeAsync(PlatformRequest request)
      Sends the request on a background thread. The future completes with the response, or exceptionally with the same PlatformException that execute(com.bilt.pos.platform.PlatformRequest) would have thrown.

    • close

      void close()
      Releases background threads and, for connections the client created itself, the connection pool. Requests after close() fail with IllegalStateException. A request still waiting for an access token fails with PlatformException, and a pending executeAsync(com.bilt.pos.platform.PlatformRequest) future completes exceptionally; neither is left waiting. Closing twice is harmless.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
